semantic_review.owner_intersection: The old predicate was owners.contains(where: navigationIdentifiers.contains(owner.identifier)). The new query asks the same direct navigationBar children to match identifier IN Array(navigationIdentifiers), then requires firstMatch.exists. For a successful query this preserves the same nonempty intersection, including the empty-set case. It does not replace ownership with a global identifier lookup.
